builders.name: basis
will: Cluster-wide Flux content of the base stack: operator installs (cert-manager, Kyverno, CloudNativePG, observability)
Kyverno cluster policies and cleanup policies (resiliency, scheduling, stateful protection, Flux governance)
Platform services shared by every namespace: the flux MCP, the logs API and logs MCP, alerting and cluster health checks
wont: Kyverno policies that generate Crossplane resources (cloud-basis)
Crossplane, Cloudflare or Google Workspace resources (cloud-basis)
AI apps, builder pod releases or app namespaces (brain)
Container images, the builder chart, node bootstrap or kube-vip (oci)

builders.name: cloud-basis
will: Crossplane install and its Cloudflare and GCP providers
Cloudflare resources: DNS, tunnels, Access apps and policies, Workers and Workers VPC services, Zero Trust
Google Workspace and GCP resources for the internal apps project
The cluster MCP connector's routes into the cluster (30-mcp)
Kyverno policies that template and generate Crossplane resources (for example a Cloudflare or GCP resource created from a label or annotation on an app object)
wont: AI apps, builder pod releases or app manifests (brain)
Container images or the builder chart (oci)

builders.name: brain
will: AI infrastructure manifests via Flux: Hermes, gbrain, Hindsight, Big AGI, collectors and ingest jobs, model config
Builder pod releases and their values: chart version pins, MCP config, secrets placeholders in the coding namespaces
The Effort MCP server deployment and other app services in the ssint namespaces
Moving image and chart pins for gbrain, hermes-agent and hindsight
wont: Building container images or changing the builder chart or builder policy (oci)
Cloudflare, Crossplane or Google Workspace resources (cloud-basis)

builders.name: oci
will: Building and publishing container images: builder-sb, cred-rotator, cluster, gbrain, agentdb
The builder Helm chart and its releases
Builder policy baked into every coding pod: managed settings, hooks, skills, agent prompts
Node bootstrap and kube-vip, the Kyverno upstream check
wont: Deploying or moving pins in the cluster (brain)
Cloudflare, Crossplane or Google Workspace resources (cloud-basis)

builders.name: projects
will: Planning and coordinating cross-repo delivery on the SimpleSalt Delivery board
Creating, splitting, updating and closing Efforts and their tasks
Anything that fits no other builder, to be raised with dylan
wont: Changing code or manifests in basis, cloud-basis, brain or oci
